rationale: The agent verified the user by email and pulled the correct account. It reviewed both recent orders with read-only tools, identified which items were gaming-related, and proposed returning only the non-gaming items. Before making any changes, it clearly listed the items to be returned and requested explicit confirmation. Upon the user’s request to refund via PayPal, it attempted the return; when the tool enforced policy (refund must go to the original method or gift card), the agent accurately communicated the constraint and obtained the user’s choice to proceed with the original Visa card. It then performed the return successfully with the correct payment method and confirmed outcomes. Finally, it honored the user’s request to speak with a human and transferred with a clear summary. Minor note: the agent stated the original payment method (Visa) before we explicitly saw payment history for order #W5490111, but this was subsequently validated by the tool’s acceptance of the Visa and rejection of PayPal for that order. No unauthorized actions or unsupported claims affected the outcome.
